page: Microsoft Azure M176-88bds_4_v3 is a memory-optimized virtual machine belonging to the MBDSMediumMemoryv3 family, running on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. It features 88 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 44 physical cores of an Intel Xeon 8473C processor operating at 4.0 GHz. The hardware configuration includes a massive memory capacity of 3892.0 GB, yielding approximately 44.23 GB of RAM per core, alongside 8192 GB of local storage with Premium Storage capability. The x86_64 architecture supports advanced instruction sets, including Intel Advanced Vector Extensions (AVX-512) and Advanced Matrix Extensions (AMX) for accelerated matrix operations.

In benchmark evaluations, this server demonstrates top-tier capabilities across multiple domains. It achieves top-tier performance in Geekbench single-core and multi-core tests, software compilation, and ray tracing. Memory bandwidth is exceptionally high, with uncached large-block read speeds reaching 419.61 GB/sec and write speeds at 181.06 GB/sec, both placing in the top 10% of tested systems. Multi-core processing is rated strong, supported by a Passmark CPU score of 94306.2. Database operations and static web serving throughput are also in the top tier, with web serving reaching 101.83 GB/sec and Redis SET operations executing at 110.02 million operations per second.

Given its massive memory-to-vCPU ratio and high-speed local storage, this instance is highly cost-efficient for memory-intensive enterprise workloads that require substantial resource density without the need for dedicated GPU hardware. The inclusion of Intel AMX instructions allows for strong CPU-based LLM inference, processing 253.8 tokens per second for medium 7B models. This server is optimally suited for large-scale relational databases, in-memory caching layers, enterprise resource planning systems, heavy software compilation pipelines, and data-dense analytics workloads.
description: The Microsoft Azure M176-88bds_4_v3 is a high-capacity, memory-optimized virtual machine from the MBDSMediumMemoryv3 family. Powered by an Intel Xeon 8473C processor with 88 dedicated vCPUs running at 4.0 GHz, it features 3892.0 GB of RAM and 8192 GB of local storage. This x86_64 server excels in memory-intensive and data-heavy operations, delivering top-tier memory bandwidth of 419.61 GB/sec for uncached reads and outstanding database performance. It supports advanced instruction sets like AVX-512 and Intel AMX, enabling strong CPU-based machine learning inference and rapid software compilation. Lacking a GPU, it relies on its high-frequency CPU and massive memory density to deliver qualitative cost efficiency for large-scale enterprise workloads. It is highly suited for large databases, in-memory analytics, and demanding enterprise applications.
